title: Private Label Branding Resources and Requirements
description:
The purpose of this form is to gather all resources and explain all the requirements needed for the Private Label project. Please answer all the questions in this form and provide all the requested resources either by uploading them in this form or by sending the files via email on the project ticket thread. Additionally, please acknowledge all the requirements and tasks that need to be completed on your side once they are done.

For any questions or additional explanations, please reach out to us via email on the project ticket thread. Please note that completing this form should be treated as a top priority.

items.title: Code Sign (Windows):
items.description:
Please follow the guide at this [URL](https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms537361(v=vs.85).aspx#The_Application_Proc). Once you obtain the **Code Signing Certificate**, please send it to us.

**Please note:** Due to recent regulatory changes, the Code Signing Certificate can no longer be obtained in digital form. You will need to source the USB and then ship it to us. Please click on this [URL](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1orGL4dagr3CyZUVArNwFMHtSArhdn-i0/view?usp=sharing) to see the instructions on How to ship to Bicom Systems in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

In case you do not send this, we will sign the app with the Bicom Systems certificate, which will display Bicom Systems as the app publisher during installation.

Please select which option for Code signing on Windows you wish to use:
options: I will obtain the code signing certificate on USB and ship it to Bicom Systems in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
I want to use the Bicom Systems code signing certificate (during installation, it will state that the app publisher is Bicom Systems).
I do not want to use any code signing certificate (the app will show as unverified and not secure during Windows installation).

items.title: Browser Extensions:
items.description:
We support Chrome and Firefox through their respective stores. Edge users can also use Chrome extensions. Safari packages can be downloaded through the client app and installed manually, while Internet Explorer works out of the box.

We will create replacements for these extensions ([gloCOM Call - Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/glocom-call/fmeenkjnbikclpgbonadanhnipgmofhn) and [gloCOM Call - Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/glocom-call/)) with your branding and send them to you once the integration of your brand is completed. You can publish them by following the guides below:

- [How to publish in Chrome Web Store](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/webstore/publish/). Additional instructions on how to publish to the Chrome Web Store can be found in this [guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ltCpL2D-1MeB97yTKhrxmDYBXS_jh4s8tj7YaeHy_6I/edit?usp=sharing).
- [How to publish in Firefox store](https://extensionworkshop.com/documentation/publish/submitting-an-add-on/). Additional instructions on how to publish in the Firefox Add-ons Store can be found in this [guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1g_L823jxejl5aFwsDlFVU3oJi78qzhUCUqnh3TFNjtI/edit?usp=sharing).
- Microsoft Edge is now based on Chromium, so our old Edge appx extensions don't work. Fortunately, users can install Chrome extensions directly in Edge, so we will use the same extension for both Chrome and Edge.
- Safari: We will provide you with the .zip file that you need to place in a publicly accessible location and send us the URL. We will then include that URL in the client application, allowing clients to download it from there.

Please copy this section and the links for later use (once the integration of your brand is complete and we send you the extensions/add-ons). You can also reach out to us via email on the project ticket thread, and we will provide you with this guide.

items.title: App Icon and Company Logo Images:
items.description:
Please click on this [LINK](https://downloads.bicomsystems.com/desktop/oem/oem_images.zip) to download the .zip file containing all the images and icon files required to create your Private Label Branded gloCOM application.

The downloaded folder will include some examples of these required images and icon files. You will need to add or replace all the necessary images and icon files in the folder, rename the folder to your company name, compress (zip) it again, and upload it by clicking on the "Add file" button.

Optionally, you can send the compressed file via email on the project ticket thread.

Please adhere to all specified image formats, dimensions, names, and folder structure.

As you will see in the ZIP file, additional tray icons will be required specifically for OSX. One is for dark tray mode, and the other is for light tray mode. Additionally, retina images are required for OSX. You will see in the ZIP file that their names have the '@2x' suffix.

items.title: iOS App Icons and Company Logos:
items.description:
Please add the three files listed below to a folder, rename the folder to '**iOS + Your Company Name**', compress (zip) the folder, and upload it by clicking on the 'Add file' button.

Optionally, you can send the compressed file via email in the project ticket thread.

Please adhere to all specified image formats and dimensions.

- Company logo (transparent): 420x140 px
- App icon for the App Store: 1024x1024 px
- App icon (only symbol, transparent): 512x512 px

If you have a vector file of your app symbol (.eps, .svg, .ai), that will be great and will result in **MUCH** better resource quality.

items.title: Android - Publishing an App on the Google Play Store:
items.description:
For publishing the Android app, we will send you a prepared app bundle for each release. You'll need to create a Play Store account and be responsible for publishing the app on the Play Store.

Instructions on how to create an account and publish the app can be found at the following links:

- [How to Get Started with Play Console](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/6112435?hl=en)
- [Prepare and Roll Out a Release](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9859348)

Please save these links for later use (once the integration of your brand is complete and we send you the prepared app bundle). You can also reach out to us via email on the project ticket thread, and we will provide you with this guide.

items.title: Web App Icons and Company Logos:
items.description:
Please add the required files listed below to a folder, rename the folder to '**Web + Your Company Name**', compress (zip) the folder, and upload it by clicking on the 'Add file' button.

Optionally, you can send the compressed file via email in the project ticket thread.

Please adhere to all specified image formats and dimensions.

**Required web app files:**

- App favicon (.ico)
- App Logo (transparent): 48x48 px
- Company Logo (transparent): 84x28 px

**Optional Meeting web app files:**

- Meeting App favicon (.ico)
- Meeting App Logo (transparent): 48x48 px

Files for the Meeting web app are optional. If you do not upload different files for the Meeting web app, same files will be used for both the gloCOM web app and the Meeting web app.

If you wish to upload files for the Meeting web app, please include "Meeting" in the file names to differentiate them.

If you have a vector file of your app symbol (.eps, .svg, .ai), that will be great and will result in **MUCH** better resource quality.
